name: @octocodeai/skills
description: Octocode agent skills — source of truth. Build syncs skill dirs to packages/octocode-pi-extension/skills/, injects packages/octocode-config/dist/index.js as octocode-config.mjs, and injects packages/octocode-memory/dist/bin/ as awareness.mjs + extract-hook-files.mjs into octocode-awareness/scripts/. Build prerequisites: @octocodeai/config and @octocodeai/octocode-memory must be built first.
